electionType: Paterson City Municipal At-Large Council & Board of Education Election
councilStructure: Faulkner Act (Mayor-Council Plan D). Voters directly elect a Mayor and 9 City Council members (6 representing geographic wards and 3 elected at-large for 4-year staggered terms).
certifiedTaxRateContext: 5.335% Total Certified Tax Rate (2026). Equalization Ratio 46.12%. Passaic County Seat.
unanimousHealthBenefitPledge: Elected officials are subject to New Jersey Chapter 78 healthcare contribution schedules and strict state-monitored fiscal compliance under DCA memorandum.

votingResources.electionDayHours: 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM EST on Tuesday, November 3, 2026

councilCandidates.name: André Sayegh
councilCandidates.experience: Serving third consecutive four-year term as Mayor; former 6th Ward City Councilman (2008–2018) and School Board Commissioner; led economic revival initiatives including Hinchliffe Stadium restoration.
councilCandidates.tagline: Economic revitalization, commercial ratable expansion, and securing historic federal infrastructure grants.
keyPlatformPillars: Leveraging Hinchliffe Stadium and Great Falls National Historical Park investments to attract private investment and expand non-residential tax ratables.
Aggressive pursuit of state and federal infrastructure grants to relieve local property taxpayers.
verifiedSources: Passaic County Clerk Official Election Certification
City of Paterson Municipal Mayoral Inaugural Records

councilCandidates.name: Lilisa Mimms
councilCandidates.experience: Incumbent At-Large Councilwoman and Council President; former Paterson School Board Commissioner; community clergy leader focused on youth development and fiscal accountability.
councilCandidates.tagline: Community empowerment, youth recreation, and rigorous scrutiny of municipal department spending.
keyPlatformPillars: Conducting rigorous Council budget hearings to restrict unvetted overtime in public safety and public works.
Expanding youth vocational training, community recreation centers, and clean neighborhood initiatives.
verifiedSources: Passaic County Clerk Certified At-Large Council Tally
Paterson City Council Official Minutes & Roll Calls

councilCandidates.name: Maritza Davila
councilCandidates.experience: Longstanding At-Large Councilwoman; veteran community leader and former Council President; focuses on constituent advocacy, municipal budget audits, and bilingual outreach.
councilCandidates.tagline: Neighborhood constituent advocacy, small business assistance, and property tax stabilization.
keyPlatformPillars: Requiring administration department heads to present monthly spending variance reports to the Council Finance Committee.
Protecting working families and senior homeowners through targeted property tax relief and tenant protections.
verifiedSources: Passaic County Clerk Official Nominating Petitions

councilCandidates.name: Michael Jackson
councilCandidates.experience: Veteran 1st Ward Council representative and outspoken fiscal critic of municipal administration spending; local entrepreneur and former restaurant operator in the historic Northside neighborhood.
councilCandidates.tagline: Aggressive taxpayer watchdog scrutiny, municipal contract transparency, and Northside flood relief.
keyPlatformPillars: Challenging municipal legal settlements and outside vendor contracts to protect taxpayer dollars.
Demanding immediate state engineering intervention for recurring Passaic River flood damage in the 1st Ward.
verifiedSources: Passaic County Clerk Certified Candidate Filings

boeCandidates.name: Joel D. Ramírez
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)
boeCandidates.experience: Elected Paterson School Board President in January 2026; focused on state aid advocacy, vocational curriculum partnerships, and bilingual learning.
boeCandidates.keyFocus: Expanding vocational academies, college dual-enrollment, and transparent budgeting for the $724M district.
boeCandidates.fiscalStance: Ensuring 84% State Aid allocation directly impacts classroom teachers and reduces overcrowding.
boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Prioritizing school facility renovations, HVAC modernizations, and athletic field restorations.

interviewStances.keyInterviewQuote: Paterson students possess limitless potential. Our board must ensure every single dollar of our budget directly enriches the student learning experience.
interviewStances.keyPriorities: Classroom instruction, bilingual education, and student mental health.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: State facility authority grants for ancient school building modernizations.

boeCandidates.name: Della McCall
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)
boeCandidates.experience: Paterson School Board Vice President; career educator and child welfare advocate; dedicated to special education resources and community school partnerships.
boeCandidates.keyFocus: Special education inclusion, early childhood reading mastery, and parent advisory councils.
boeCandidates.fiscalStance: Zero-waste educational procurement and auditing third-party special education vendor billings.
boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Safe school walking corridors, cafeteria nutrition upgrades, and modern digital library media centers.

interviewStances.keyInterviewQuote: Every child, regardless of zip code or background, deserves a world-class public education in a safe, modern classroom.
interviewStances.keyPriorities: Early literacy benchmarks, special needs services, and parent engagement.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: Transparent school board committee audits and community forum workshops.

boeCandidates.name: Kenneth L. Simmons
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)
boeCandidates.experience: Longtime School Board Trustee and former Board President; corporate operations manager with extensive governance experience overseeing district finance.
boeCandidates.keyFocus: Fiscal governance, collective bargaining compliance, and rigorous STEM curriculum standards.
boeCandidates.fiscalStance: Holding the district administration accountable for every line item in the $724M budget.
boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Fast-tracking capital improvement repairs with NJ Schools Development Authority (SDA).

interviewStances.keyInterviewQuote: Fiscal discipline and educational excellence go hand in hand. We must demand measurable outcomes for every taxpayer dollar spent.
interviewStances.keyPriorities: STEM curricula, competitive teacher compensation, and fiscal transparency.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: Independent external forensic audits and SDA capital project oversight.

boeCandidates.name: Corey L. Teague
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)
boeCandidates.experience: Veteran School Board Commissioner and passionate civic activist; champions student rights, anti-bullying initiatives, and school safety.
boeCandidates.keyFocus: Restorative justice, community safety, and empowering grassroots parent organizations.
boeCandidates.fiscalStance: Ensuring district funds prioritize teacher classroom supplies over executive administration bonuses.
boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Upgrading perimeter security cameras, visitor management, and clean drinking water filtration.

interviewStances.keyInterviewQuote: I speak directly for the parents and children of Paterson who feel unheard. Our schools must be sanctuaries of hope and learning.
interviewStances.keyPriorities: Anti-bullying enforcement, clean water in schools, and direct teacher classroom stipends.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: Eliminating no-bid consultant contracts and expanding afterschool programs.
